title: 既存の3D素材を探し、一式で受け取る

source.license: Apache-2.0; original font (OFL) and dependency notices retained as shipped
source.what_it_is: A toolkit for finding existing 3D assets and downloading the files a source allows (library, CLI, REST API, MCP server) plus Markdown instructions for AI agents (web/src/content/SKILL.md, AGENTS.md). Not a 3D generator, model or image generator.
source.this_example: The original Claude Opus 5.5 wrote run.mjs and the viewer; the production operator ran Node once with the original AssetService, createHttpClient, polyhaven, fab, selectFiles, totalBytes, expandFiles and downloadFiles. Hosted server, REST, MCP and web UI were not used. Two providers enabled (polyhaven, fab).

sizes.composition: rail/title/sub at top, diagram world 700x1032 at y=202 using the tall concept layout (book, MCP/REST tag and request card left; AI, run.mjs and operator right; AssetService bar; Poly Haven | Fab; candidates | Fab result; budget gate with 1k lane left and 8k side lane right; folder | still image), foot line at y=1256

title/sub left, rail right, diagram world 1240x586 at y=108 using the separate wide layout (book/tag/request | AI, run.mjs, operator | AssetService, providers, candidates, gate with 8k side lane under candidates and 1k lane under Fab | still image above folder), foot line at y=708

example_records.upstream_steps_shown: A01 candidates and provider states; A03 total is equal to the A08 total

assets.gate: All 25 files are fetched once, size and SHA-256 checked against the pinned manifest; quotes are checked on their lines; the 8 result IDs and inputs, the source commit, the 115-file lock entries of the 8 vendored files, and the deep values of the 3 record wrappers against asset-runs.json are checked; A08 counts/bytes and the 5 model files, A04 budget/error/no download and A07 skipped/no Fab request are checked. The still image is decoded only from its verified bytes.
assets.live_calls: None. No vendor Node code, no Poly Haven or Fab request, no AI, no search or download is run by the page or the film. Frames draw saved values only.

persistent_shapes: book: the Markdown instructions (SKILL.md and AGENTS.md) as one open book with three tabs 検索/確認/取得 and five rule marks (IDの書き方, 用途で形式, ライセンス, 直接不可→URL, 容量を先に); slate = read/written by AI
other: a dashed folded tag 他の入口 MCP / REST with stamp 未実行, attached to the book; never flows
request: card 木箱 / Web / CC0 / 4MiB (budget read from the verified data)
ai: dashed slate pill AI（Opus） 読んで書く; book and request copies travel into it and merge
script: run.mjs page written by the AI (code-line glyphs only, no code text); its copy is handed to the operator
operator: copper node 制作担当 Nodeで1回実行 — the separate step that actually ran the original library
service: 原典 AssetService bar; a copper pulse splits to Poly Haven (solid, API・直接取得) and Fab (dashed, リンクだけ)
cands: A01 candidates from the record (Crate 01 chosen, Crate 02, Military Crate); the chosen crate card gains CC0 (green) and glTF 1k (copper) tags
fabres: A01 検索URL link icon; later A07 skipped stamp with 通信なし・エラーではない

gate: two lanes. A08 1k: five tiles (gltf, bin, diff, nor, arm) and a budget bar filled to 2.17MiB of 4MiB with a check. A04 8k side lane: five tiles, bar filled to the end, stop mark and closed rail; no folder, no request
folder: polyhaven-wooden_crate_01/ with gltf and bin at the root and three images under textures/ (same tile shapes), summary gltf + bin + 画像3, later a ZIP chip

preview: the verified still concept/actual-crate.png (operator's capture of the real GLTFLoader canvas), credit James Ray Cock / Poly Haven・CC0, later a 実3D chip; revealed top-down only, never warped or rotated

scenes.title: 既存の3D素材を探し、一式で受け取る
scenes.sub: 3D Asset Server：AIが読む手順書と、検索・確認・取得の道具
scenes.conveys: What it is: a Markdown instruction book beside an asset search/download tool. No generated model, no AI brain image.
scenes.incoming: Empty frame; camera centred on book + service + providers.
scenes.events: Book appears (0.2-0.8 s) and opens (0.5-1.4 s); tabs (1.0-2.0 s); rule marks (1.6-2.8 s); AssetService (0.9-1.4 s) and both providers with their lines (1.3-1.8 s); MCP/REST tag (2.6-3.1 s).
scenes.outgoing: Camera moves to the handoff area (3.3-4.0 s).

scenes.title: 渡す：手順書と依頼から、AIが run.mjs を書く
scenes.sub: Nodeで実行したのは制作担当（別の工程）
scenes.conveys: Instructions and request are handed to the AI, which authors a script; a separate operator step runs it. Actor ownership explicit.
scenes.events: Request card (4.0-4.4 s) and AI node (4.2-4.6 s); lines (4.4-4.8 s); book and request copies merge into the AI (4.7-5.7 s); run.mjs appears and is written (5.6-6.6 s); operator appears (6.4-6.8 s); script copy handed to the operator (6.8-7.6 s); operator lit (7.5-7.9 s).
scenes.outgoing: Camera moves to operator + service + providers (7.6-8.3 s).

scenes.title: 原典の AssetService が配信元へ振り分ける
scenes.sub: Poly Haven から候補3件・Fab は検索URLだけ（通信なし）（count read from the record）
scenes.conveys: Routing to two enabled providers. Poly Haven returns three candidate cards; Fab returns only a link. The same chosen crate card gains license and format tags.
scenes.events: Pulse operator -> service (8.0-8.8 s) then splits to both providers (8.4-9.6 s); candidate and Fab areas appear (9.2-9.6 s); three cards arrive from Poly Haven (9.7-11.2 s); link icon arrives from Fab (9.9-10.9 s); CC0 and glTF 1k tags (11.6-12.8 s).
scenes.outgoing: Camera moves to candidates + gate (13.6-14.3 s).

scenes.title: 取得の前に、合計を予算と比べる
scenes.sub: A08 1k 2.17MiBは通る・A04 8k 113.14MiBは通信0件で止まる (values read from the records)
scenes.conveys: The chosen card opens into five files; totals are compared with the 4MiB budget before any folder or request. A04 is a separate recorded operation on a side lane, not an automatic retry or downgrade.
scenes.events: Gate appears (14.0-14.4 s); routes draw and flow (14.2-15.2 s); the card splits into five tiles on both lanes (14.8-16.4 s); bars fill (16.6-17.6 s); 8k stop mark and closed rail (17.8-18.6 s).
scenes.outgoing: Camera moves to gate + folder + still (19.6-20.3 s).

scenes.title: 受け取る：5ファイルが相対パスのままフォルダーへ
scenes.sub: gltf + bin + 画像3・James Ray Cock / Poly Haven / CC0
scenes.conveys: The same five 1k tiles join one folder with relative paths kept (root + textures/), then the verified still of the real 3D view appears with credit. Fab direct-only (A07) is shown as skipped, distinct from the budget stop.
scenes.incoming: 1k tiles waiting above the open bar; 8k tiles stopped.
scenes.events: Folder (20.0-20.4 s); tiles pass the gate into their slots (20.6-22.4 s); still frame (22.2-22.6 s) revealed top-down (23.0-24.0 s); A07 skipped stamp (24.2-25.0 s).
scenes.outgoing: Camera moves to folder + still (25.6-26.3 s).

scenes.title: 保存した実物を、実3DとZIPで使う
scenes.sub: 保存した記録と実ファイルを読むだけ（再検索・再取得なし）
scenes.conveys: The folder becomes a usable ZIP and the still links to the real interactive 3D. Pictorial handoff only; no OS download happens in the film.
scenes.events: ZIP and 実3D chips appear (26.2-27.4 s).

scenes.title: 既存の3D素材を探し、一式で受け取る
scenes.sub: 手順書と依頼 → AIが書く → Nodeで実行 → 配信元・選択・予算 → 実物
scenes.conveys: Stable whole structure, understandable without sound.
scenes.incoming: All lines flow-coloured and emphasis back to full (28.3-28.9 s); camera pulls back to the whole diagram (28.2-28.9 s); title and rail switch 28.5-28.9 s.
scenes.events: None. Still from 28.9 s to 32 s; poster at 31 s.

quoted_values_source: Candidate titles, provider states, file tags, totals, budget, request counts, folder name, credit and image are read from the verified records and files at load time. The A04 error message and byte counts appear in the page DOM, not as a long text slide.
limits: Motion is an explanation of the recorded flow, not the original run's timing or an internal trace.
Only two providers (polyhaven, fab) were enabled; the 23 supported sources were not all tested.
Saved search results, order and tookMs are from the original run; not a current ranking.
Hosted server 3d.shep.bot, REST, MCP and the web UI were not used. The MCP/REST tag marks other documented entrances only.
File and glTF structure checks are not a visual quality, performance or human approval claim.
wooden_crate_01.bin is served from an 8k path but is the shared 189,408 B geometry; 1k refers to texture resolution.

scope.original_production: Original authoring of run.mjs, model-view.js, app.js, the desk page and the 28 s film by the original Claude Opus 5.5 run; the production operator's single Node run (8 operations, 39 checks, 8 live requests = 3 API + 5 file), independent 212 checks and separate offline replay 29 checks. None rerun for this revision.
scope.parent_packaging: concept/structure.json, concept/manifest.json, concept/records/*.json (UTF-8/LF wrappers of the same asset-runs results), concept/actual-crate.png (operator's capture), desk.html and video/legacy.html archives, and later visual-guide.md / visual-verification.json / source.zip / media.
scope.new_authoring: This revision's diagram, motion, controls and Japanese copy (index.html, concept.css, concept.js, video/index.html, video/video.css, video/video.js, video/storyboard.json, video/README.md), written by claude-opus-5-5.
